records.title: Use a SQLite-backed serial campaign coordinator
Allow unrestricted campaign auto-merge after evidence gates

research.sqliteTransactions: Use synchronous better-sqlite3 transactions with BEGIN IMMEDIATE for compare-and-set mutations and automatic rollback on exceptions.
research.partialIndexes: Use SQLite unique partial indexes to enforce one active campaign per repository/base branch and one active cycle per campaign.
research.conflictHandling: Use SQLite ABORT semantics and translate constraint failures to typed campaign conflicts; do not use REPLACE.

web.reason: This prerequisite increment has no HTTP or portal surface.

research.effectivePricingLookup: Resolve pricing synchronously at campaign creation and immediately before model turns using the price effective at the check time.
research.transactionPattern: Use better-sqlite3 transaction.immediate() so pricing validation and campaign creation are one atomic write decision.
research.waitStatePattern: Persist a pricing-specific waiting_for_external marker and restore only the same cycle's prior runnable status.
research.unknownPricePolicy: Reject autonomous campaign models without pricing while preserving manual-task unpriced usage reporting.

web.reason: Campaign portal model selectors are scoped to ext-001.

research.authorizationPattern: Mount router-level ADMIN middleware across the complete campaign control surface.
research.repositoryValidation: Use the GitHub branch endpoint with configured credentials before campaign persistence.
research.socketPattern: Broadcast serializable campaign detail events through the existing Socket.IO server.
research.webPattern: Use a Next.js Client Component for interactive controls, browser authentication, and live Socket.IO refreshes.

failedRuns.failure: Cucumber UI scenario timed out because the CI web client used a cross-origin API URL with credentialed requests instead of the existing same-origin Next.js API proxy.

ci.localValidation: Campaign controls UI scenario passed through the same-origin proxy: 1 scenario, 7 steps.

playwright.failure: The production HTTP/2 response had an empty statusText, so the non-admin portal displayed a generic API error instead of Admin access required.

research.finding: Fetch Response.statusText can be empty for HTTP/2 responses; error classification must use the numeric Response.status.

implementation.behavior: All generic API client failures now include the numeric HTTP status and optional status text.

research.exactShaReads: Resolve the campaign branch once, then read repository trees and file contents by the resulting immutable commit SHA.
research.promptSecurity: Treat repository, GitHub, runtime, and ideation text as untrusted data; redact secret-shaped values and neutralize nested delimiter tokens before persistence.
research.persistence: Store the snapshot JSON beside base_sha on the autonomous cycle in one immediate SQLite transaction with replay-by-cycle idempotency.

research.copilotSdk: The installed @github/copilot-sdk 0.3.0 supports raw JSON Schema custom tools but not response-schema output; use one restricted submission tool per isolated generator or critic session and validate again in-process.
research.copilotSdkUpgrade: The registry reports 1.0.7-preview.3, but upgrading is unnecessary for ext-003 and would introduce unrelated preview breaking changes.
research.sqliteTransactions: Use synchronous better-sqlite3 transactions with the immediate variant so state revalidation and proposal/history compare-and-set writes share one write lock.
research.fingerprinting: Use Node crypto SHA-256 over canonical JSON after lowercase, trim, whitespace collapse, and lexicographic scope sorting.

research.sqliteTransactions: Use better-sqlite3 immediate transactions and unique partial indexes for exact-once cycle linkage.
research.scheduler: Use recursive unref timers, non-overlapping ticks, round-robin campaign selection, and heartbeat every owned lease.
research.remoteRecovery: Persist deterministic branch, image, preview, and pull-request checkpoints before or immediately after remote mutation, and reuse open PRs by head branch.

research.sdkAbortPattern: Use CopilotSession.abort() to interrupt only the active message while preserving the durable task, branch, and session evidence.
research.transactionPattern: Use synchronous better-sqlite3 transaction.immediate() mutations; never hold a SQLite transaction across asynchronous work.
research.usagePattern: Count one turn per completed model action and use stable usage event identifiers so cost deltas are idempotent.
research.externalWaitPattern: Close the active elapsed-time interval before an external wait and open a new interval only when the same attempt resumes.

web.reason: This increment adds no new operator UI or frontend contract.

bugfix-001.description: Started campaigns generate accepted proposals and ordinary visible workstreams without blocking other campaigns; creation intent is explicit in the portal.

research.mergeSafety: Lock every campaign squash merge to the explicitly reviewed pull-request head SHA.
research.reviewEvidence: Persist reviewer acceptance, validation health, reviewed SHA, and review time on the campaign task.
research.baseConfirmation: Confirm the merge commit is reachable from the configured base branch, not merely equal to its current tip.
research.checkDiscovery: Wait 30 seconds for GitHub check runs to register before treating a zero-check repository as having no CI.
research.serialization: Advance cooldown to exactly one next cycle in one immediate SQLite transaction.

bugfix-002.description: Recover campaign delivery when git push recovery changes the live pull-request head after validation evidence was recorded.

research.finding: Use an explicit expected remote SHA with force-with-lease and confirm the remote branch from a fresh fetch before persisting release evidence.

campaignRecovery.nextWorkstreamName: [Campaign crgarcia12/obelisco #3] Extend spec validation to cover task-to-requirement traceability

bugfix-003.description: Preserve a repository-supplied Dockerfile.liliput instead of overwriting it with a generic Node entrypoint during preview rebuilds.

bugfix-004.description: Automatically resume a campaign coder when the release reviewer requests changes, without starting duplicate task pipelines.

campaignReviewerLoop.nextWorkstreamName: [Campaign crgarcia12/obelisco #3] Extend spec validation to cover task-to-requirement traceability

bugfix-005.description: Resolve pushed task branch SHAs directly from the remote when shallow single-branch clones do not create origin task-branch tracking refs.

research.finding: Use git ls-remote --exit-code with the exact refs/heads task branch so strict SHA confirmation does not depend on a single-branch clone's restricted remote tracking refspec.

ext-008.description: Preserve the managed delivery contract across all agent turns and fail closed at specification, validation, Git, CI, merge, rebuild, and autonomous proposal boundaries.

gherkinDeltas: Recovery turn retains the approved delivery contract
Validation cannot pass when Cucumber executes zero scenarios
Direct delivery merges only the checked pull request revision
Rebuild current revision without modifying source

web.reason: The increment changes delivery orchestration and safety gates without changing the portal surface.

aspire.testHarnessRecovery: Restarted with the system Node path and authenticated GitHub CLI token.

research.finding: End-to-end reliability requires reinjecting immutable task context on every turn and using deterministic evidence gates rather than trusting conversational memory or success-shaped fallbacks.

research.durabilityPattern: Persist campaign state and remote checkpoints; use idempotent transitions and renewable leases.
research.sdkSessionPolicy: Treat Copilot SDK sessions as ephemeral workers, not durable campaign state.
research.releasePattern: Campaign-marked PRs bypass RM webhook/polling dispatch; success requires explicit merge and base-SHA confirmation.
research.acceptedRisk: No sensitive-path denylist or mandatory human approval; tests and LLM review gate all campaign diffs.

campaignCreationUx.decision: Expose separate Save draft and Create and start actions so operators can choose whether configured campaign budgets activate immediately.
campaignCreationUx.framework: Keep the interactive form in the existing Next.js Client Component and reuse the create/start API contracts.
